planner_response.title: Discount is applied twice
planner_response.message: Discounted subtracts the percent twice, so 100 at 20 percent becomes 60 instead of 80.

planner_response.title: Dependency leftpad v1.2.3 is on the known-exploited list
planner_response.message: The change requires evil.example/leftpad v1.2.3, and the sample advisory table has a known-exploited row for that version.

planner_response.title: note may include a payment token
planner_response.message: note returns a payment string and nothing shows it is free of a token.

planner_response.title: CVE-2026-0001 for leftpad v1.2.3 is on the KEV list
planner_response.message: The change requires evil.example/leftpad v1.2.3. The sample KEV view has CVE-2026-0001 for that advisory.
